builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: A creditor beating a debtor
missions.kicker: River Market · A creditor beating a debtor
missions.button: Zahir is beating Fadil at the quay

a.text: Zahir the boat owner has Fadil by the collar and is hitting him. “Two months! Two months you've owed me!” Fadil's family is watching from the steps.

choices.label: Pull them apart and ask Zahir to give him time
Pay part of the debt · 10 coins

time.text: You get between them. Zahir is still angry, but he lets go. “A month,” he says. “Not a day more.” Fadil's wife brings you a cup of water.

paid.text: You put ten coins in Zahir's hand. He lets Fadil go and counts them, then nods. “The rest in a month.”

past.text: Behind you the shouting goes on.
